'''Maric Tovar''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] and later, the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].

==Biography==
Maric Tovar lived during the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and he worked as an [[Engineer/Legends|engineer]]. However, on one occasion while he was assisting a woman who had a problem with her [[Droid/Legends|droid]], the two of them were attacked by Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and Tovar was forced to flee with the woman. He subsequently joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and he became a member of the crew of the Alliance [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Lazy Katarn]]''. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], Tolas and the rest of the crew of the ''Katarn'' were sent to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Dalicron-4]], to find [[Caeleb]], the "Child of Light," a prophesied child who was strong in [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. After arriving on the planet, Tovar and the rest of the agents rescued Caeleb from the clutches of the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Tol Skaros]] and brought the child into the custody of the Alliance.<ref name="COL" />

Four months later, Caeleb was kidnapped by the Dark [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Thaum Rystra]], and Tovar the crew of the ''Katarn'' were again dispatched to find the child. They tracked Rystra to [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]] and from there, they followed him to the planet [[Pamorjal]]. However, the ''Lazy Katarn'' was destroyed by the [[Pamorjal Freeman's League]], a local resistance group, and Tovar and the other Rebels began to fly in the [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000 light freighter]] ''[[Celestial Dancer]]'' instead. They eventually attacked Rystra inside the [[Cavern of Light]] on the world [[ZXK-100346.6a]] and rescued Caeleb.<ref name="Soulsaber">"[[Soulsaber (adventure)|Soulsaber]]"</ref>

The Alliance later [[Declaration of a New Republic/Legends|reformed]] itself and become the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], and Tovar continued to serve the new government. The [[Force ghost/Legends|Sith spirit]] [[Valik Kodank]] sought to [[Essence transfer|transfer her consciousness]] into the [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] [[Sha'lia]], a member of the ''Celestial Dancer{{'s}}'' crew that Tovar secretly had a crush on, and the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] determined to manipulate Tovar into helping her to achieve her goal. While Tovar was on a mission with the [[New Republic Intelligence Service]], assisting them with [[Slicer/Legends|slicing]] into an Imperial [[Computer/Legends|computer]] network, Kodank appeared to him and she promised to teach him to use the Force and to make Sha'lia fall in love with him if he led the crew of the ''Celestial Dancer'' to [[Temple of Pain|Kodank's temple]] in the [[Tascollan Nebula/Legends|Tascollan Nebula]]. Tovar accepted her offer and Kodank sent him on various missions, to help him to develop his [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]]. In about [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]], Thaum Rystra lured the ''Celestial Dancer'' to Kodank's [[temple]] and there, Tovar, Sha'lia and the rest of the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter's]] crew confronted Rystra and Kodank.<ref name="LAD" />

{{RPG|[[Light and Dark (adventure)|''Light and Dark'']]}}
Despite Valik Kodank's manipulation of him, Tovar helped the other New Republic agents to defeat Rystra and vanquish Kodank's spirit. They then fled the temple while the building collapsed around them and they departed from the Tascollan Nebula aboard the ''Celestial Dancer''.<ref name="LAD" />
{{Endgame}}
